extensions.meta.title: Extensions and integrations - TypeWhisper
extensions.meta.description: TypeWhisper for Chrome and Firefox, Raycast, and Stream Deck, an MCP server, tools for the Pi coding agent, and the command line, with install links.
extensions.label: Extensions
extensions.title: TypeWhisper in your other tools
extensions.lede: Dictate in the browser, control TypeWhisper from Raycast or a Stream Deck, and give coding agents access to transcription and your dictionary. Every extension talks to the TypeWhisper app through its local API.
extensions.requirement: Needs the API server: Settings › Advanced
extensions.index.label: On this page
extensions.browser.label: Browser
extensions.browser.title: TypeWhisper for Chrome and Firefox
extensions.browser.lede: Dictate into any text field in the browser, and let website workflows match the page you are on.
extensions.browser.item1: Start or stop a dictation with Alt+Shift+D (⌥⇧D).
extensions.browser.item2: Right-click a text field and choose Dictate with TypeWhisper.
extensions.browser.item3: Optional microphone button in the focused text field.
extensions.browser.item4: Tells TypeWhisper which website is open, so website workflows match. This also works in the Mac App Store edition, which cannot read browser addresses itself.
extensions.browser.item5: Talks only to TypeWhisper's local API on 127.0.0.1. Private windows are never shared.
extensions.browser.chromeText: Edge, Brave, and other Chromium browsers install it from here too.
extensions.browser.setup: Needs TypeWhisper for Mac with the API server turned on. In TypeWhisper, open Settings › Advanced, turn on the API server, click Copy API Token, and paste the token into the extension.
extensions.raycast.label: Raycast
extensions.raycast.title: TypeWhisper for Raycast
extensions.raycast.lede: Control TypeWhisper from Raycast without leaving the keyboard.
extensions.raycast.item1: Start a dictation, or dictate with a specific workflow.
extensions.raycast.item3: Transcribe audio files, and start or stop the recorder.
extensions.raycast.item4: Manage the dictionary and your workflows.
extensions.raycast.storeText: Finds TypeWhisper's API port and token automatically.
extensions.streamDeck.label: Stream Deck
extensions.streamDeck.title: TypeWhisper for Stream Deck
extensions.streamDeck.lede: Keys for dictation, workflows, and the recorder.
extensions.streamDeck.platforms: macOS and Windows · Stream Deck 7.1 or later
extensions.streamDeck.item1: Start and stop dictation. The key shows whether TypeWhisper is idle, recording, or processing.
extensions.streamDeck.item2: Workflow dictation. On Stream Deck +, turn the dial to choose a workflow.
extensions.streamDeck.item3: Recorder for the microphone, system audio, or both.
extensions.streamDeck.item5: Add the term on the clipboard to the dictionary.
extensions.streamDeck.downloadText: Open the .streamDeckPlugin file and confirm in Stream Deck. The plugin finds TypeWhisper's API port and token automatically.
extensions.mcp.label: MCP server
extensions.mcp.title: MCP server
extensions.mcp.lede: Lets coding agents and other MCP clients transcribe files, check model status, search your transcription history, and manage dictionary terms and corrections.
extensions.mcp.platforms: TypeWhisper for Mac or Windows · Node.js 20 or later
extensions.mcp.setup: Most MCP clients start the server with this configuration. It finds the running TypeWhisper app automatically.
extensions.mcp.githubText: Configuration, a remote TypeWhisper host, and the list of tools.
extensions.pi.label: Pi
extensions.pi.title: TypeWhisper for Pi
extensions.pi.lede: Tools for the Pi coding agent: transcribe files, search your transcription history, check models, and manage the dictionary.
extensions.pi.platforms: TypeWhisper for Mac or Windows · Pi 0.80.6 or later · Node.js 20 or later
extensions.pi.setup: Then restart Pi. The extension finds the running TypeWhisper app automatically.
extensions.pi.githubText: Example requests, configuration, and a remote TypeWhisper host.
extensions.cli.label: Command line
extensions.cli.title: Command line
extensions.cli.lede: Use TypeWhisper from the terminal, scripts, and local automation.
extensions.cli.macText: Install it from Settings › Advanced › Command Line Tool. Transcribe files and back up your settings.
extensions.cli.windowsText: Use TypeWhisper from PowerShell and scripts.
